allhands-bot: Thanks for joining — using this thread for follow-ups from today's all-hands Q&A about product timelines (API / Console / Optimize). Post short questions; PMs/ENG will reply here.
Sam (Product): Quick note: API streaming GA target moved to late June; Console feature-flag rollout targeted mid-Aug; Optimize public beta targeted Sep. Will publish final dates next Wed.
Ravi (Eng): Clarify: Streaming GA depends on runtime v2.1 and KV-cache improvements. Is v2.1 on track?
Matt (DevEx): Yes, runtime v2.1 is in release candidate, infra cutover scheduled for 2 weeks. If RC holds, we go GA in that window.
Lina (Design): For Console feature flags — are we keeping the old / new nav? Need to prep screenshots for customers by July 10.
Sam (Product): Plan is to show it as an optional "Beta features" toggle; Lina I'll DM you designs. July 10 timeline ok.
Ava (Sales): Customers are asking about enterprise audit logs in Console. Is that part of the Aug rollout or separate?
Sam (Product): Audit logs are a separate add-on; delivery is late Q3. We can offer a preview for committed Q customers earlier.
Jo (CEO): Prioritization note: if Optimize beta impacts latency >5% we delay. We need solid perf numbers before we open to customers.
Ravi (Eng): Understood. We'll run a perf matrix on the candidate quantization changes and post results here mid-next-week.
Matt (DevEx): SDK changes needed for streaming: small surface area. We'll publish a migration guide and a sample: `const r = await client.generate({stream: true})`
Sam (Product): Action items: 1) Publish firm GA dates next Wed. 2) Lina to share Console mockups by July 3. 3) Ravi to post perf results by next Tues. 4) Matt to draft SDK migration guide.
Ava (Sales): Can we add an FAQ snippet for customers about fallbacks and SLA expectations?
Sam (Product): Yes, will add to the roadmap doc and ping marketing.
allhands-bot: Thanks — we'll keep this thread updated. If you asked a question live and didn't get an answer, drop it here and tag @Sam (Product) or @Ravi (Eng). :thumbsup:
